message.content:
A typical medium‑sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 calories**.  
If you’re looking at it by weight, tomatoes have about **18 kcal per 100 g**.  

So:

| Size / Weight | Calories |
|---------------|----------|
| 1 small tomato (~80 g) | ~15 kcal |
| 1 medium tomato (~123 g) | ~22 kcal |
| 1 large tomato (~182 g) | ~32 kcal |
| 100 g of tomato | ~18 kcal |

These values can vary slightly depending on the variety and ripeness, but they give a good estimate for most everyday tomatoes.
